info.title: Unikraft Cloud Control Plane API
info.description: This specification describes the Unikraft Cloud Control Plane API, which provides mechanisms to interact with globally provided Unikraft Cloud system.

servers.description: Official Unikraft Cloud Control Plane API

post.description:
CheckAuthorization is used to check the authorization status of a request.
 It streams responses back to the client, indicating whether the signin
 request is authorized or not.

RequestSignin initiates the sign-in process and returns an authorization
 URL.  The user should be redirected to this URL to complete the sign-in.

request_id.description:
The request ID is a unique identifier for the request.  This is used to
 track the request in the system and should be provided by the client.

CheckAuthorizationRequest.description: The request message for checking authorization given a request ID.

message.description: An optional message providing additional information about the response.

data.description: The response data for this request.

op_time_us.description:
The operation time in microseconds.  This is the time it took to process
 the request and generate the response.

CheckAuthorizationResponse.description: The response message for checking authorization.

token.description: The authorization token which can be used to authenticate requests.

hostname.description:
The hostname is the name of the machine making the request.  This is
 mandatory as it consitutes a unique identifier for the machine.

os.description: The operating system of the machine making the request.

os_version.description:
The version of the operating system of the machine making the request, if
 available.

 For Android, it's like "10", "11", "12", etc.  For iOS and macOS it's like
 "15.6.1" or "12.4.0".  For Windows it's like "10.0.19044.1889". For FreeBSD
 it's like "12.3-STABLE".  For Linux, this is simply the kernel version on
 Linux, like "5.10.0-17-amd64".

container.description: A best-effort whether the client is running in a container.

distro.description: The OS distribution, if known.  E.g. "debian", "ubuntu", "nixos", ...

distro_version.description: The OS distribution version if known.  E.g. "20.04", ...

distro_codename.description: THe OS distribution codename if known.  E.g. "jammy", "bullseye", ...

cli_version.description:
The CLI version is the version of the Unikraft CLI that is making the
 request.

goarch.description: If available, the GOARCH value (of the built binary).

goos.description: If available, the GOOS value (of the built binary)

go_version.description: if available, the Go version binary was built with.

RequestSigninRequest.description: The request message for a sign-in request.

message.description: An optional message providing additional information about the response.

data.description: The response data for this request.

op_time_us.description:
The operation time in microseconds.  This is the time it took to process
 the request and generate the response.

RequestSigninResponse.description: The response message for a sign-in request.

authorization_url.description: The full URL which can be used to remotely confirm the signin.

request_id.description:
A unique identifier for the request.  This can be used to track the
 request in the system.
